title: SIEVE: A Parameterized GitHub Corpus Builder for Software Engineering Research
abstract: arXiv:2610.22544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Software engineering research increasingly relies on large, richly annotated corpora of real-world code. Still, researchers typically assemble these with ad-hoc scripts or static, pre-built datasets that offer no control over corpus composition. This leaves a gap for a reusable tool that goes below the repository level and builds annotated, function- and class-level code corpora under researcher-specified criteria. We present SIEVE (Software Ingestion & Extraction for Verifiable Evaluation), an open-source, parameterized GitHub corpus builder that, unlike repository-level mining tools, works at code granularity: it locates individual functions, methods, and classes in repositories and extracts them as records, giving direct control over corpus construction based on several criteria, including widely used programming languages (Python, Java, JavaScript, C++), repository quality, and creation date. To support software engineering research

translated_title: SIEVE：一个面向软件工程研究的参数化GitHub语料库构建工具
translated_abstract: 软件工程研究日益依赖于大型且具有丰富标注的真实世界代码语料库。然而，研究人员通常使用临时编写的脚本或静态的预构建数据集来组装这些语料库，无法对语料库的组成进行控制。这就留下了一个空白：需要一种可复用的工具，能够深入到仓库级别以下，按照研究人员指定的标准构建带标注的函数级和类级代码语料库。我们提出了SIEVE（Software Ingestion & Extraction for Verifiable Evaluation，用于可验证评估的软件摄取与提取工具），这是一个开源的、参数化的GitHub语料库构建工具。与仓库级挖掘工具不同，它在代码粒度上工作：它能够在仓库中定位单个函数、方法和类，并将其提取为记录，从而基于多项标准直接控制语料库的构建，这些标准包括广泛使用的编程语言（Python、Java、JavaScript、C++）、仓库质量和创建日期。为了支持软件工程研究……
tldr: SIEVE是一个开源、参数化的GitHub语料库构建工具，能够在函数、方法和类的代码粒度上，根据编程语言、仓库质量和创建日期等标准提取带标注的代码语料库，为软件工程研究提供了对语料库组成的直接控制能力。
en_tdlr: SIEVE is an open-source, parameterized GitHub corpus builder that extracts annotated function-, method-, and class-level code records based on criteria such as programming language, repository quality, and creation date, giving researchers direct control over corpus composition for software engineering research.
